meta.name: minimal-run-and-audit
meta.description: Rigor Run skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to capture or normalize evidence from the selected smoke test or documented inference or evaluation command and write standardized `repro_outputs/` files, including patch notes when repository files changed. Do not use for training execution, initial repo intake, generic environment setup, paper lookup, target selection, hidden scientific-meaning changes, or end-to-end orchestration by itself.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑通论文仓库的推理或评估命令,归档成可复核的复现结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有需要复现的深度学习论文仓库,想留下可核查的运行证据
copy.tagline_en: Run a paper repo's documented commands and archive checkable reproduction evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must reproduce a deep-learning paper repo and keep verifiable run evidence

howto.what: 它会执行你选定的 smoke test,或 README 里写明的推理、评测命令,再把执行结果整理成 repro_outputs/ 下的标准化文件;如果仓库文件被改动,还会附上补丁说明。
howto.when: 当你已经有复现目标和环境方案,需要一条短的、非训练的验证命令(如 smoke test、文档里的推理或评测命令)的执行证据时,由它接管。

say.text: 跑一下这个仓库的 smoke test,结果写进 repro_outputs/
say.note: 会执行并生成标准化输出文件

say.text: 执行 README 里的推理命令,并记录执行证据
say.note: 会汇总结果并区分已验证、部分、受阻

say.text: 我改了仓库文件,跑完后把改动记进 PATCHES.md
say.note: 改动会作为补丁说明记录

howto.what_en: It runs your chosen smoke test or the documented inference/evaluation command, then writes standardized files into repro_outputs/, plus patch notes if repo files changed.
howto.when_en: Use it once a reproduction target and setup plan exist, when you need execution evidence from a short non-training run such as a smoke test or documented inference command.

say_en.text: Run this repo's smoke test and write the results to repro_outputs/
say_en.note: Executes it and writes normalized output files

say_en.text: Run the inference command from the README and record the evidence
say_en.note: Summarizes the run as verified, partial, or blocked

say_en.text: I edited repo files; add the changes to PATCHES.md after the run
